description: First slice of the fz-rh2.17.5.6.8 struct-facts decomposition (investigation proved it is not one atomic commit). Add a first-class StructDef store keyed by ModuleId (ordered fields + provenance) and FactKey::StructDefined(ModuleId), published when a module body containing defstruct settles -- replace the ScopeForm::Struct(_) no-op in source_publish.rs apply_scope_form. Model on the existing ModuleInterface publication + TypeDefMap/FactKey::TypeDefined patterns. NO consumer migrated here; the old module_struct_fields/struct_schemas source-scan stays the sole reader for now. Test: StructDefined publishes independently of ModuleDefined. Later slices migrate consumers; .8.5 deletes the scan.

comments.text: Folded at 34eb21461 (audit-clean). Adversarial audit found NO MUST-FIX: store fidelity byte-for-byte identical to the old module_struct_fields scan (both read the same parse_struct_form AST node -> sound foundation for slices .10-.13), publish timing mirrors other co-outputs (ProtocolDispatch/ModuleIndexed), additive-only (resolve/body/semantic/backend untouched, confirmed by diff), demand_fact_producer catch-all safe (StructDefined never demanded), behavior-neutral (matrix 18 unchanged). Test-gap NIT applied at fold: the independence test now also pins store CONTENT (fields == [x,y] in source order, via the struct_def/defined telemetry payload). Two follow-ups filed: fz-rh2.17.5.6.8.1 (duplicate-defstruct first-vs-last landmine + defstruct default-value form) gating .13. lib 1248/0/6, matrix 18 known-red, clippy+fmt clean. Unblocked .10 (obligation store + resolve migration) and .12 (typed protocol-impl-target).

title: Structs: add StructDef store + FactKey::StructDefined published on defstruct settle
